issues.text: New in round 2. In "When it ends, it deletes…" the two "it" have no clear antecedent: the previous clause's subject is "the output above", and "the script" is buried inside it. I had to re-read to see that the script, not the output, deletes the ApplicationSet, the Secrets and the folder.
issues.quote: When it ends, it deletes the ApplicationSet, both cluster Secrets and `platform/regions/`.
issues.fix: Replace "When it ends, it deletes" with "When `applicationset.sh` ends, it deletes".
